en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This is a lot more spacious than I thought.
You can move pretty easily on all fours.
Let's look around for clues.

It'd look pretty stupid if we found no clues
after crawling around in this dusty place.
Y-Yeah...

<CLT=cltMIND>I think there are still things
to investigate here...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>Blood dripping from the gaps
in the floorboards...

<CLT=cltMIND>Fresh blood.
This is definitely Tenko's.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a bloodstain on the ground
underneath the loose floorboard.

<CLT=cltMIND>But that's pretty far from where
Tenko's blood is dripping down...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's under the same floorboard...
just at different ends.
<CLT=cltMIND>Why is there blood here?

Hey, the back of this floorboard has blood
on it, too.

You're right...there's a little bit of blood
on the underside of this floorboard.

Did Tenko's blood spatter here when she
got killed?
I wonder... I can't really be sure yet.

But these bloodstains here are
completely dry.

<CLT=cltMIND>There must be some reason these
particular stains are dry...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Dried Blood Under the Floor<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Loose Floorboard<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a bloodstain on the ground
underneath the loose floorboard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a good distance from the spot
where Tenko's blood pooled.
<CLT=cltMIND>Why is there a bloodstain here?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's also blood on the underside
of this floorboard.

<CLT=cltMIND>Was this also from when Tenko
was killed? I don't know...

<CLT=cltMIND>But these bloodstains are
completely dry.
<CLT=cltMIND>What could that mean...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Some of the wood has corroded and is broken
off, so you can see into the next room...

This is...the wall of the empty room, right?
Looks like there's wood along the wall...
This part has rotted away.

It looks like natural rot...
This hole wasn't made intentionally.

But I can get into the next room through
here.

If I remember correctly, the room next door
is also empty, right?

Then the culprit could've gone from room to room
by moving under here instead of using the hallway.

True, but it would have been difficult
moving around under the floor.

We did alright because we had a light.
Without that, it'd be pitch-black.

That might make it impossible
to move around in there.

Then they could've used a light, like we're doing
right now.
True...

<CLT=cltMIND>They used a light to move around
under the floor? Is that possible?
<CLT=cltMIND>Part of the wood has rotted away.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like natural rot.
This hole wasn't made intentionally.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is near the wall to the room next door.
You could get there through this space.

<CLT=cltMIND>So, you could go from room to room
under the floor...
<CLT=cltMIND>But it would be completely dark.

<CLT=cltMIND>Without some kind of light to guide you,
it wouldn't be possible to move around.

<CLT=cltMIND>Could the culprit have brought a light
with them under the floor?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a sickle here!
And there's blood all over it!

The blood on this sickle is fresh...
This is it. This is the murder weapon!
This...came from my research lab.
It did?
A sickle can be used to assassinate a target.

It can be thrown without losing any lethality,
and you can hide it under your clothes, too.

If she was attacked with this, she wouldn't
stand a chance. The blade is about six inches...

And since Tenko was in the cage, she wouldn't
have been able to defend herself.
But even if this *is* our murder weapon...
How did the culprit attack Tenko in the cage?

The blade could fit through the gaps in
the cage, but could it reach her neck?

The cage is three feet high... If you were to
stab into it with a six-inch blade...

Well, it would depend on Tenko's posture...
but I don't think it's impossible.
<CLT=cltMIND>Then her posture is the question...

Hey... If the weapon is down here, the culprit
must've thrown it away, right?

Perhaps after killing Tenko, the culprit threw
the sickle under the floor in the dark.

Or, they could have been under the floor the
entire time. Either of those is possible.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Sickle Under the Floor<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
<CLT=cltMIND>A bloody sickle has been dropped here.

<CLT=cltMIND>The blood is still wet. It must be the
weapon used to kill Tenko.
<CLT=cltMIND>This weapon was from Maki's lab.

<CLT=cltMIND>The blade is about six inches,
deadly in a fight.

<CLT=cltMIND>But how did the culprit attack Tenko
in the cage with the sickle?

<CLT=cltMIND>The blade might fit through the gaps in
the cage, but could it reach Tenko's neck?

<CLT=cltMIND>The cage is about three feet tall, so
sticking a six-inch blade in that...

<CLT=cltMIND>It would all depend on her body position
inside the cage.
<CLT=cltMIND>In addition to all that...

<CLT=cltMIND>If we assume the weapon is down here
because the culprit threw it here...

<CLT=cltMIND>Then either the culprit threw the sickle
down here in the dark after the murder...

<CLT=cltMIND>or the culprit was under the
floor the whole time.
<CLT=cltMIND>Which could it be...?

Ah, look! Part of the crosspiece that supports
the floorboard is cut off.

It's near the loose floorboard, and the portion
missing is about the same width, too.
And from what I can see of it...

It wasn't broken off naturally.
This was cut by someone.

There should be saws in the warehouse,
so they could have used that...
The question is, why?

Another crosspiece is supporting the floorboard,
so it might not fall if this portion is missing...
So what purpose did this serve?

<CLT=cltMIND>The floorboard underneath Tenko's body is loose,
and the crosspiece supporting it has been cut...
<CLT=cltMIND>If the culprit did all of this...then why?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Crosspiece Under the Floor<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added
to the Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>A piece has been cut out of the crosspiece
that is supporting the loose floorboard...
<CLT=cltMIND>And from what I can see of it...

<CLT=cltMIND>It wasn't broken off naturally.
It must have been cut by someone.

<CLT=cltMIND>There should be saws in the warehouse,
so assuming they used that...
<CLT=cltMIND>Why would they do all this?

<CLT=cltMIND>The floorboard Tenko's body is on is loose,
and the crosspiece under it is cut off...
<CLT=cltMIND>If the culprit did all of this...then why?

<CLT=cltMIND>The fact that Tenko's body is on top of
the loose floorboard can't be coincidence.
<CLT=cltMIND>I think we've finished investigating here.
Maki, you want to head back up?

Glad you asked... I was starting to get fed up
with all this dust.

<CLT=cltMIND>After Maki and I crawled out from under
the floor, we put the floorboards back...
<CLT=cltMIND>And returned to our investigation.
